ENV-01.notes: Read from the source at tag 2.1.2 (commit d57e97e), which is the installed build. The module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu, so there are no menu lines. The 1ms and 10 second endpoints are ENV_MIN_TIME and ENV_MAX_TIME at lines 6-7, fed through knobToSeconds. They are the one-pole time constant rather than the time the stage takes to finish: the attack aims at 1.2 and stops at 1.0 (lines 12, 106-111), so a full rise takes rather longer than the figure on the knob. No derived figure is quoted in the lines. The decay approaches the sustain level and never formally arrives, so there is no separate sustain stage in the code.

CLK-01.notes: Read from the source at tag 2.1.2 (commit d57e97e), which is the installed build. The module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu, so there are no menu lines. NSE-01.notes: Read from the source at tag 2.1.2 (commit d57e97e), which is the installed build. The module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu, so there are no menu lines. The pink filter is Paul Kellet's economy version, coefficients at lines 54-60; the 0.11 scaling at line 60 is what matches its level to the white path. ATT-01.notes: Read from the source at tag 2.1.2 (commit d57e97e), which is the installed build. The module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu, so there are no menu lines. Neither jack is given a family: the module scales and offsets whatever is patched to it, so a colour would be a guess. The knob defaults to +1 rather than to the centre (line 32), so a new ATT-01 passes its input at full level. The ±12V clamp at line 58 is the only limiting in the module.
